# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 1.x     | Yes       |

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this SDK, please email **security@wajub.com** instead of opening a public issue. Include the SDK version, a description of the issue and, when possible, steps to reproduce it.

We acknowledge reports within two business days and keep you informed while the issue is being fixed. Please give us reasonable time to release a fix before any public disclosure.

The wider Wajub vulnerability disclosure process is described on [docs.wajub.com](https://docs.wajub.com/resources/compliance).
